_provenance: SYNTHETIC. Written 2026-09-30 to match what the fixed WF5 pipeline produces for the six confirmed gut-and-amend bills, while the live versions corpus was being regenerated and its rows were known-defective. Row shape is exactly mirror.mirror_impact_statement_versions (typed columns + verbatim sheet row in "row"). Codes and dates for s1071-119, hr5334-119, hr6500-119, hr2872-118 and s870-118 are as congress.gov reported them; hr815-118 had no rows and its codes and dates are illustrative. Replace with live rows via `node tools/dump-version-fixtures.mjs` — the tests read this file and assert behaviour, never prose, so they need no change.
